newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan starts selling new 'March' compact.
newsitem.headline: Nissan starts selling new 'March' compact.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd said on Monday it had started selling a partially remodelled version of its compact car called the March in Japan.
Japan's second biggest carmaker started selling the new March, called Micra in Europe, on Monday with a monthly sales target of 10,000 units.
The March is Nissan's mainstay compact car.
The new March features standard safey devices such as dual airbags and an anti-lock brake system.

The domestic sales price will start at 947,000 yen for the 1-litre engine 3-door hatckback version. Nissan has no plans to export the March. Its British unit produces the Micra for the European market.
